objective: Validar READ_ONLY la conexion canónica registrada CAVAS mediante su ServerID, permitiendo explicitamente el registro inactivo. La infraestructura debe resolver internamente la credencial registrada GptEscritura. No aceptar ni exponer host, usuario, password o connection string en el job. Confirmar DB_NAME, identidad efectiva y acceso a metadata minima de cavas_www. Sin DDL/DML, sin filas de negocio y sin Produccion.

queries.name: connection_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS effective_login,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login

queries.name: database_access
queries.sql: SELECT DB_ID('cavas_www') AS db_id,HAS_DBACCESS('cavas_www') AS has_dbaccess

queries.name: schema_probe
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 5 s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id ORDER BY s.name,t.name

constraints: include_inactive=true is explicit for this diagnostic
